With the stock at US$94.52 after several years of mixed performance, the issue now is how well that market tag lines up with the earnings investors are paying for. items.title: Stryker Sinks 5% on Q3 Miss and Guidance Cut: “Fall Short of Our Expectations”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStryker shares fell 5% after third-quarter sales and adjusted EPS missed estimates and it cut its 2026 guidance. Stryker blamed a slowing market, but Johnson & Johnson grew hips and knees faster in the same quarter, which points to Stryker’s own execution.
